description.en-US: The concrete variant this balance is held for. A stock transaction must reference a variant, never a template, because a template alone does not identify a physical article (BR 3.1).

Lot or serial identifier. A plain string rather than a reference because no Lot master data exists yet. Empty string for 'not tracked', never null: it is part of the quant's unique key, and SQL uniqueness does not constrain null rows against each other. Required for create so the composite unique can include it; the default supplies the empty value.
Physical package identifier. Empty string, never null, for the same reason as lot_ref.
Owner of the goods when they are not the company's, e.g. consignment stock. Empty string, never null, for the same reason as lot_ref.
The unit the stored quantities are expressed in. Quantities are always kept in the variant's base unit so that balances from different transactions can be added.

Physical quantity present. System-managed: it is changed only by a completed stock move, never by a client write, so that every change traces back to a movement (BR 3.3, AC-STOCK-002). Negative values are representable so that an oversell can be recorded and then corrected rather than silently clamped.
Quantity promised to an outgoing move but not yet moved. System-managed by the reservation engine, and never negative (STOCK-INV-002).
on_hand_quantity minus reserved_quantity, computed on read. Virtual: storing it would be a third number that can disagree with the two it derives from (BR 4.2.2.3).
When this balance entered the location. Used by removal strategies such as FIFO.
Quantity a physical count found. Recording it does not change on_hand_quantity; only applying the adjustment does (BR 4.2.7.3).
Whether a count has been entered and is awaiting apply. Distinct from counted_quantity being zero, which is a legitimate count result.

on_hand_quantity as it stood when the count was entered. Apply must reject a count whose snapshot no longer matches, because the variance would otherwise be computed against a balance that has since moved (STOCK-INV-008).
When this balance is next due to be counted. Filtering on it is what produces a cycle-count worklist.
